items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I actually study with a guy at the University of Vermont, Peter Bouchard, who is a classical trombonist, and I’ve certainly learned a great deal about playing the trombone

ctx.x: You must have progressed pretty quickly as a trombone player I guess, in keeping up with that company.

Well you know there weren’t a lot of recordings made. We actually have a recording from Carnegie Hall but other than that there isn’t much. I wished I did because it would be fun. I’ve asked, since I’ve retired in the last three years, I’ve actually taken up the trombone after playing it for fifty years and I actually study with a guy at the University of Vermont, Peter Bouchard, who is a classical trombonist, and I’ve certainly learned a great deal about playing the trombone and I think I’m a much better…
